$schema_note: Policy registry for --auto goal selection (hub #53/#71 + v2 amendment, supersedes design #18 O2). Maps goal slug -> hub goal issue + policy binding: status, grant_profile, and the repo-level backlog feeds that can't be sub-issues. Direction lives in the goal issue's prose; membership is the goal issue's sub-issue links, generated at read time; priority is the selecting session's judgment. Inside the policy-file carve-out: PRs touching this file are never merged unattended. Adding a goal here is what makes it selectable by --auto.
